# JobberRecruit

> JobberRecruit (https://jobberrecruit.com) is Nigeria's leading recruitment and career portal, connecting job seekers with verified employers across Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and all 36 Nigerian states. The platform offers AI-powered resume builders, ATS optimization, online training with instant certification, and direct job applications.

## Core Features & Offerings

- [Find Jobs](https://jobberrecruit.com/jobs): Browse thousands of verified job listings across tech, finance, engineering, healthcare, marketing, sales, and remote roles in Nigeria.
- [AI Career Tools](https://jobberrecruit.com/ai-tools/resume-builder): Create ATS-optimized resumes, practice AI mock interviews, and receive personalized career advice.
- [Training & Certification](https://jobberrecruit.com/training): Access professional skill courses in data analysis, digital marketing, project management, and cybersecurity with instant certificates.
- [Employer Services](https://jobberrecruit.com/employer/post-job): Post jobs for free, access verified candidate databases, and manage recruitment via an intuitive dashboard.
- [Career Blog](https://jobberrecruit.com/blog): Expert guides on job hunting, interview tips, salary trends, and navigating the Nigerian job market.
- [CV Review Service](https://jobberrecruit.com/cv-review): Professional CV rewrite and expert review tailored for Nigerian and global job markets.

## Key Entities & Locations

- **Supported Regions**: Lagos, Abuja (FCT), Port Harcourt (Rivers State), Ibadan (Oyo State), Kano, Enugu, and Remote Nigeria.
- **Top Industries**: Information Technology, Banking & Finance, Oil & Gas, Healthcare, Education, Marketing, Operations.
- **Organization Type**: Job Portal & Talent Acquisition Platform.
